Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using COVID-19 themed emails with malicious Excel attachments containing macros
Malicious macros execute to download and install the NetSupport Manager client from a remote site
NetSupport Manager client masquerades as dwm.exe in %AppData% folder
Remote administration tool used as RAT to gain remote control, execute commands, drop multiple components (.dll, .ini, .exe, VBScript, obfuscated PowerSploit-based PowerShell script)
Connects to C2 server for further commands
Impacted Systems: Windows machines infected via malicious Excel files
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious Excel attachments titled 'covid_usa_nyt_8072.xls'
Indicators of Compromise: NetSupport Manager client saved as dwm.exe under random %AppData% folder
Connection to same URL to download payload
Dropped files including .dll, .ini, .exe, VBScript, PowerSploit-based PowerShell script
Use of obfuscated formulas in Excel files
